additionalKits.clockwork: Style or subject contains steampunk, clockwork, gears, brass: add clockwork doc and source.
additionalKits.glow: Fantasy/anime/game styles map above; also add glow for magic, fire/flame, light/lantern/candle, crystal/orb, neon, molten/lava, rune or spirit features.

briefTemplate:
Complete assignment thoroughly:

# Target
Slug: `{slug}`. Sandbox: `{sandbox}`. Write only `samples/{slug}.ts` (and throwaway files in `scratch/{slug}/`, deleted at the end).

# Change
Category: {category}
Subject: {subject}
Style: {style}.

# Acceptance
GUIDE.md's done-criteria, `meta` with `style: "{style}"` and `commit: "88fc1f0"`, exactly two renders (v01 first draft, v02 final).
toolPolicy: Current repo reads; virtual sample writes and native hashline edits; harmless scratch commands succeed; real targeted typecheck; no rendering; continue until natural/yield or 17 total calls.
